description: This file is a CMake module script used to locate and configure the LXC (Linux Containers) library within a build system. It checks for the presence of LXC using pkg-config, sets up library paths, and defines imported targets for use in CMake projects.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Locates the LXC package using pkg-config and sets relevant variables.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for the presence of the lxc package via pkg-config.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Finds the lxc library file in specified hints.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles standard arguments for package detection and sets the found variable.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Creates an imported target for the LXC library.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties for the imported LXC target, such as location and compile options.
